name: Security Strategy of the Slovak Republic (Bezpečnostná stratégia Slovenskej republiky) (2021)
description: Security Strategy of the Slovak Republic (Bezpečnostná stratégia Slovenskej republiky)
relationToCloudSecurity: Defines national cybersecurity, critical infrastructure protection, and digital sovereignty priorities issued by National Cyber Security Centre SK-CERT (nbu.gov.sk) applicable to cloud service providers and operators.
relationToAISecurity: Addresses strategic emerging technology governance, AI security/capability priorities, and national resilience policy for National Cyber Security Centre SK-CERT (nbu.gov.sk).
